jobs.title: Audit Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
PwC Job Notification 2027 is hiring Audit Assistants (0-2 years) for CA in Pursuing across Bengaluru, Kolkata & Delhi NCR. Check details and apply now!

New Delhi:PwC Acceleration Center India has officially invited online applications for the Audit Assistant position across multiple major Indian cities. Listed on the official Naukri recruitment portal, this Big 4 opening is specifically tailored for candidates who are CA in Pursuing with 0 to 2 years of experience.

For commerce graduates and Chartered Accountancy aspirants seeking global assurance exposure, this PwC Job 2027 offers a structured entry into audit operations across Bengaluru, Kolkata, and Delhi / NCR. Eligible candidates should review the official requirements below and submit their applications online before hiring slots fill up.

About PwC Acceleration Center India

PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the world’s leading Big 4 professional services networks, providing assurance, advisory, and tax services to global organizations. Within India, PwC Acceleration Center India acts as a specialized delivery hub supporting international engagement teams with high-quality audit and assurance execution.

Joining PwC as an Audit Assistant equips early-career finance professionals with hands-on exposure to international accounting standards, risk assessment methodologies, and enterprise audit tools.

Role and Responsibilities of PwC Job Notification 2027

As an Audit Assistant at PwC Acceleration Center India, selected candidates support global assurance engagement teams throughout the audit lifecycle. Core duties generally involve:

  • Audit Execution & Testing: Perform substantive audit testing, verify financial documentation, and validate client account balances under senior supervision.
  • Data & Financial Analysis: Review ledgers, trial balances, and supporting schedules to identify discrepancies or compliance gaps.
  • Documentation & Workpapers: Prepare accurate, well-organized audit workpapers in line with PwC quality and regulatory standards.
  • Team Coordination: Collaborate seamlessly with onshore and offshore audit teams across multiple time zones to meet project milestones.

Eligibility Criteria of PwC Job Notification 2027

Before submitting your profile on the recruitment portal, verify that you meet the core eligibility benchmarks specified in the listing:

Educational & Experience Requirements

  • Academic Qualification: Candidates must be CA in Pursuing (pursuing Chartered Accountancy alongside relevant commerce graduation).
  • Experience Level:0 to 2 years of relevant audit, accounting, or assurance experience. Freshers meeting the academic criteria are eligible to apply.
  • Preferred Locations: Applicants must be willing to work from Bengaluru, Kolkata, or Delhi / NCR.

Essential Skills for Shortlisting

  • Strong foundational knowledge of accounting principles, auditing standards, and financial statements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and digital documentation tools.
  • Clear written and verbal business communication skills for interacting with global audit teams.

Salary and Vacancy Details

  • Salary Package: PwC has not officially disclosed the exact compensation package on the public job listing. Compensation is discussed directly with shortlisted candidates during the HR interview round.
  • Number of Vacancies: Exact opening counts are not publicly specified; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

How to Apply for PwC Job Notification 2027 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these steps to submit your application through the official job listing:

  1. Open the Official Job Portal: Visit the verified PwC Acceleration Center India Audit Assistant Listing on Naukri.
  2. Log In or Register: Sign in to your Naukri account (or create a free job seeker profile if you are a new user).
  3. Update Your Resume: Upload an updated PDF resume clearly highlighting your CA pursuing status, accounting knowledge, Excel skills, and preferred city (Bengaluru, Kolkata, or Delhi / NCR).
  4. Click Apply: Review your contact details and submit your application directly through the portal.
